title: ר' חנינא בר סיסי

paragraphs: R. Chanina bar Sisi was splitting wood. R. Yochanan told him, “This does not befit your honor”: Jerusalem Sanhedrin, end of chapter 2. Berakhot, chapter 6, mishnah 5, has bar Kissui; Sheloshah SheAkhelu, mishnah 2, has Inyani bar Sisi, as does Rabbah, Mikketz, section 91 [the retrieved Rabbah reads Chanina bar Sisi]. Apparently this is R. Chanina bar Sisi; I therefore write R. Inyani here. See R. Chanina ben Pazi above. In R. Elazar's name: Jerusalem Talmud, Bameh Ishah [the retrieved witness has R. Eliezer]. He went up to Tzipporin to R. Chanina; the passage says that he wished to transmit the Explicit Name to him [the pronoun’s referent is uncertain]. R. Chanina's son hid under the bed and sneezed. He said, “You practice deceit: neither to you nor to him”: Jerusalem Yoma, chapter 3, halakhah 7. With R. Yonah: Maaser Sheni, chapter 4. R. Yehoshua bar Avin, in his name. R. Simon, in his name. Tosafot, Berakhot 48a, has R. Chanina bar Sarsi; he was R. Yosi ben Chalafta's uncle; see there.
